content.text:
Perfect! I've successfully added weekly subscription support to subtrack. Here's what was implemented:

## Changes Made

### Core Functionality (src/cycles.js)
- Added `CYCLE.WEEK` constant for weekly subscriptions
- Updated `MONTHS_PER_CHARGE` to handle weekly with `12/52` (since weekly price × 52 ÷ 12 = monthly equivalent)
- Updated `nextCharge()` to handle weekly cycles by adding 7 days at a time from the first charge

### CLI Updates (bin/subtrack.js)
- Updated `USAGE` to show `--every month|year|week`
- Added "week" and "weekly" to the `EVERY` mapping
- Updated `SHARE_PER_MONTH` with weekly conversion (52/12)
- Updated error message to mention "week" as a valid option

### Bug Fix (src/renewals.js)
- Fixed sorting to use `date` instead of `when` label for correct chronological ordering (was causing month boundary issues)

### Tests
- Added 2 CLI integration tests for weekly subscriptions
- Added 2 unit tests for weekly cycle calculations
- All 38 tests pass ✅

## Example Usage
```bash
$ subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week
Added Meal kit: €59.90 weekly, €259.56 a month.

$ subtrack list
Meal kit      €59.90 weekly      €259.56 a month

$ subtrack renewals --within 30
27 Oct  Meal kit  €59.90
```

Ready to commit when you approve!
